tools.name: find_product_coupons
tools.description: Finds current coupon codes for a specific product across all the stores McClipFace (formerly Clippy) covers, with codes that only work on that product listed first. Codes come from affiliate networks and a licensed coupon data partner (same data as GET https://mcclipface.com/api/coupons?product=...)

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_coupons, find_product_coupons, get_deals · Private data: report_coupon_result · Public sink: find_coupons, find_product_coupons, get_deals, report_coupon_result.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_coupons, find_product_coupons, get_deals · Private data: report_coupon_result · Public sink: find_coupons, find_product_coupons, get_deals, report_coupon_result

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
